job.job_description:
Roles and Responsibilities :

Design, develop, and deploy large language models using Azure AI services such as PineCone.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to integrate generative AI capabilities into existing systems.
Develop high-quality code in Python for fast API integration and retrieval augmented generation tasks.
Ensure scalability, reliability, and performance of deployed models.

Job Requirements :

6-10 years of experience in software development with expertise in cognitive computing and generative AI.
Strong proficiency in programming languages such as Python.
Experience with cloud-based platforms like Azure AI Services (PineCone).
Knowledge of vector space modeling techniques for text processing.
